findings.claim: The bullet pre-game rating went from 695 (Aug 2021) to 807 (Oct 2026), with a low of 160 (Apr 2022) and a peak of 1300 (Apr 2025).

findings.caveat: The climb was not monotone: bands below the current rating hold games from the climb and from the descent.

findings.claim: The blitz pre-game rating went from 800 (Aug 2021) to 956 (Dec 2025), with a low of 252 (Mar 2022) and a peak of 1050 (Feb 2024).

findings.caveat: Rating bands and years overlap heavily; 2024 is thin.

findings.claim: In blitz, higher centipawn loss per move goes with a lower pre-game rating, holding the other per-game metrics fixed, also within years.

findings.section: 6. Performance vs opponent rating and upsets
findings.claim: In rated games the pairing is tight: the median absolute rating difference is 22 points and most games are within 50 points.
findings.metric: share of rated games with |opponent rating minus own rating| <= 50
findings.caveat: The opponent's pre-game rating is reconstructed (post-game rating plus the player's rating change) and approximate under Glicko.

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: Against rated opponents more than 100 points stronger the player scored well above the Elo expectation of 0.256.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated games with opponent rating difference > 100
findings.caveat: Outer bins are small; the reconstruction bias would push towards under-performance against stronger opponents, so the excess is not an artefact of it.

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: Against rated opponents more than 100 points weaker the player scored in line with the Elo expectation of 0.724.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated games with opponent rating difference <= -100
findings.caveat: Outer bins are small (tens of games).

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: Against rated opponents 50 to 100 points stronger the player scored above the Elo expectation of 0.397.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated games with opponent rating difference 50..100

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: Against rated opponents 25 to 50 points stronger the player scored slightly above the Elo expectation of 0.447.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated games with opponent rating difference 25..50

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: Against rated opponents 50 to 100 points weaker the player scored in line with the Elo expectation of 0.602.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated games with opponent rating difference -100..-50

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: The excess over the Elo expectation against opponents more than 100 points stronger is present when the player's own rating was below 700.
findings.metric: score minus Elo expectation, rated games with opponent rating difference > 100, own pre-game rating < 700
findings.caveat: Wide pairings were more common when the player was low-rated and climbing fast.

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: The excess over the Elo expectation against opponents more than 100 points stronger is also present when the player's own rating was 700 or more.
findings.metric: score minus Elo expectation, rated games with opponent rating difference > 100, own pre-game rating >= 700
findings.caveat: Small cell (79 games).

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: The mean rating gain for a win against opponents more than 100 points stronger was +16.4, against +8.8 for even opponents, roughly as Elo predicts, so the outer-bin opponents were not mostly provisional accounts.
findings.metric: mean rating change for a win, rated games with opponent rating difference > 100
findings.caveat: Elo ratio 1.44, observed 1.88; the gain against opponents more than 100 points weaker was +5.1 (Elo ratio 0.53, observed 0.58).

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: Against rated opponents more than 100 points stronger both sides lost more expected points per move than at even pairings, and the player no more than the opponents.
findings.metric: ep lost per move, player vs opponents, rated games with opponent rating difference > 100
findings.caveat: No paired difference is printed in the rating-difference tables.

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: Against rated opponents more than 100 points stronger the player lost more centipawns per move than those opponents did.
findings.metric: cp lost per move, player vs opponents, rated games with opponent rating difference > 100
findings.caveat: No paired difference is printed in the rating-difference tables.

findings.section: All rated games, by rating difference
findings.claim: Against rated opponents more than 100 points stronger the player converted winning positions more often than those opponents did.
findings.metric: conversion: P(win | reached P(win) >= 0.8), player vs opponents, rated games with opponent rating difference > 100
findings.caveat: The player's conversion exceeds the opponents' in every rating-difference bin.

findings.claim: In rated bullet games against opponents more than 100 points stronger the player scored far above the Elo expectation of 0.254.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated bullet games with opponent rating difference > 100
findings.caveat: Small cell; the 50..100 bin also shows an excess (0.078 [0.002, 0.157]).

findings.claim: In rated blitz games against opponents more than 100 points stronger the player scored above the Elo expectation of 0.261.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated blitz games with opponent rating difference > 100
findings.caveat: Small cell (84 games).

findings.claim: In rated blitz games against opponents more than 100 points weaker the player scored below the Elo expectation of 0.704, with a CI that includes zero.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated blitz games with opponent rating difference <= -100
findings.caveat: Small cell (76 games).

findings.claim: In rated blitz games against opponents 0 to 25 points stronger the player scored above the Elo expectation of 0.482.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated blitz games with opponent rating difference 0..25
findings.caveat: The 25..50 bin shows the same (0.058 [0.007, 0.114]).

findings.claim: In rated rapid games against opponents 25 to 50 points stronger the player scored above the Elo expectation of 0.449.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, rated rapid games with opponent rating difference 25..50
findings.caveat: Rapid has no > 100 bin with 20 games; the 0..25 bin also shows an excess (0.089 [0.012, 0.170]).

findings.claim: In unrated games, where the opponent's rating is exact, the score against opponents more than 100 points stronger was above the Elo expectation of 0.190 but the CI includes zero.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, unrated games with opponent rating difference > 100
findings.caveat: Loose pairing in unrated games (median |difference| 104); mean difference in this bin 360 points.

findings.claim: In unrated games against opponents more than 100 points weaker the player scored in line with the Elo expectation of 0.816.
findings.metric: score and score minus Elo expectation, unrated games with opponent rating difference <= -100
findings.caveat: Mean difference in this bin -307 points.

findings.section: Upsets: wins against opponents at least 100 points stronger
findings.claim: There were 95 upset wins (opponent at least 100 points stronger) and 70 upset losses (opponent at least 100 points weaker), rated and unrated.
findings.metric: number of upset wins
findings.caveat: 84% of upset wins and 71% of upset losses were rated games.

findings.section: Upsets: wins against opponents at least 100 points stronger
findings.claim: In upset wins the stronger opponent lost more expected points per move than the player did.
findings.metric: ep lost per move, player vs opponent, upset wins (opponent >= +100)
findings.caveat: Ordinary wins within 25 points show the same gap (0.0244 vs 0.0313).

findings.section: Upsets: wins against opponents at least 100 points stronger
findings.claim: In upset wins the stronger opponent lost on time in 40% of the games, about as often as in ordinary wins within 25 points (0.436 [0.413, 0.460]).
findings.metric: share of upset wins in which the loser (the opponent) flagged
findings.caveat: Small cell; all games, rated and unrated.

findings.section: Upsets: wins against opponents at least 100 points stronger
findings.claim: In upset wins the loser's decisive blunder was found in 56% of games, the same as in ordinary wins (0.566 [0.543, 0.590]).
findings.metric: share of upset wins in which the loser's decisive blunder was found

findings.section: Upsets: wins against opponents at least 100 points stronger
findings.claim: In upset losses the player lost more expected points per move than the weaker opponent, and far more than in ordinary losses (0.0319 [0.0304, 0.0334]).
findings.metric: ep lost per move, player vs opponent, upset losses (opponent <= -100)
findings.caveat: Small cell (70 games).

findings.section: Upsets: wins against opponents at least 100 points stronger
findings.claim: In upset losses the player lost about 90 centipawns per move against the weaker opponent's 71.
findings.metric: cp lost per move, player vs opponent, upset losses (opponent <= -100)
findings.caveat: Ordinary losses within 25 points: 80 [78, 82] vs 60 [58, 61].

findings.section: Upsets: wins against opponents at least 100 points stronger
findings.claim: In upset losses the player was still alive (P(win) >= 0.1) at the end in 47% of games, against 0.396 [0.366, 0.422] in ordinary losses.
findings.metric: share of upset losses in which the loser (the player) was still alive (P(win) >= 0.1)
findings.caveat: Small cell; the model keeps flag chances alive in bullet, so about half of bullet checkmates count as 'still alive'.

findings.section: Upsets: wins against opponents at least 100 points stronger
findings.claim: In upset losses the player lost on time in 31% of games, against 0.349 [0.327, 0.374] in ordinary losses.
findings.metric: share of upset losses in which the loser (the player) flagged
findings.caveat: Small cell (70 games).
